# Wayland display backend: libwayland-client + xdg-shell code generated by
# wayland-scanner from wayland-protocols (packages: libwayland-dev,
# libwayland-bin, wayland-protocols).
pkg_get_variable(WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR wayland-protocols pkgdatadir)
set(XDG_SHELL_XML ${WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR}/stable/xdg-shell/xdg-shell.xml)

set(GENERATED_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
set(XDG_SHELL_HEADER ${GENERATED_DIR}/xdg-shell-client-protocol.h)
set(XDG_SHELL_CODE ${GENERATED_DIR}/xdg-shell-protocol.c)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${XDG_SHELL_HEADER} ${XDG_SHELL_CODE}
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${GENERATED_DIR}
    COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER} client-header ${XDG_SHELL_XML} ${XDG_SHELL_HEADER}
    COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER} private-code ${XDG_SHELL_XML} ${XDG_SHELL_CODE}
    DEPENDS ${XDG_SHELL_XML}
    VERBATIM
)

# The generated protocol code is C (the project itself is CXX-only).
enable_language(C)

add_library(firmir-gui-wayland SHARED wayland.cpp ${XDG_SHELL_CODE})
set_target_properties(firmir-gui-wayland PROPERTIES
    PREFIX ""
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${FIRMIR_GUI_PLUGIN_DIR})
target_link_libraries(firmir-gui-wayland
    PRIVATE firmir-gui-backend firmir-core ${WAYLAND_CLIENT_LIBRARIES})
target_include_directories(firmir-gui-wayland PRIVATE
    ${GENERATED_DIR} ${WAYLAND_CLIENT_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_directories(firmir-gui-wayland PRIVATE
    ${WAYLAND_CLIENT_LIBRARY_DIRS})
# The generated protocol C file is not -Wall clean; do not fail it on -Werror.
set_source_files_properties(${XDG_SHELL_CODE} PROPERTIES
    COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")
# shm_open needs -lrt on glibc < 2.34.
find_library(RT_LIBRARY rt)
if(RT_LIBRARY)
    target_link_libraries(firmir-gui-wayland PRIVATE ${RT_LIBRARY})
endif()
